title: "A7 high-temperature pressure comparison"

A7 comparison record; adopted parameter identity linked from the [overview](../notebook.qmd#working-record).

# Question

How well does A7 reproduce the retained high-temperature CO₂ pressures?

# Result

The retained cohort errors describe non-fitted predictions. Overlapping canonical and packet views are not independent observations, and this comparison does not qualify high-temperature process use.

# Basis and method

Average absolute relative deviation (AARD) is computed within each named retained cohort; source, temperature, pressure basis and row availability remain in the source-state assessment.

# Values

## Cohort comparison {#high-temperature-pressure-comparison}

A7's 100–120 °C comparisons preserve source and cohort membership from [state-targets.csv](../results/a7-paper-evidence/state-targets.csv). Canonical and packet rows overlap and are separate views, not additional independent observations. Their source-state bases and access history remain those of the retained assessment. These non-fitted predictions do not qualify high-temperature process use. No matched A7 no-heat calculation was made.

# Limits and evidence type

These are non-fitted comparisons at the retained source states. Data-access history and overlapping membership limit an independent-prediction interpretation. No matched no-heat calculation was made.
